title: The yeast CST and Polalpha/primase complexes act in concert to ensure proper telomere maintenance and protection.
authors: Calugaru, Kimberly; Yu, Eun Young; Huang, Sophie; Gonzalez-Rodriguez, Nayim; Coloma, Javier; Lue, Neal F
one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜和AlphaFold建模研究CST与Polalpha/primase复合物在端粒维持中的互作，虽涉及蛋白-DNA复合物结构，但核心是端粒复制调控而非TF-DNA转录结合，且方法以结构解析为主，与课题聚焦的TF-DNA互作建模关联有限。
abstract: Polalpha/primase (PP), the polymerase that initiates DNA synthesis at replication origins, also completes the task of genome duplication by synthesizing the telomere C-strand under the control of the CTC1/CDC13-STN1-TEN1 (CST) complex. Using cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) structures of the human CST-Polalpha/primase-DNA complex as guides in conjunction with AlphaFold modeling, we identified structural elements in yeast CST and PP that promote complex formation. Mutating these structures in Candida glabrata Stn1, Ten1, Pri1, and Pri2 abrogated the stimulatory activity of CST on PP in vitro, supporting the functional relevance of the physical contacts in cryo-EM structures as well as the conservation of mechanisms between yeast and humans. Introducing these mutations into C. glabrata yielded two distinct groups of mutants. One group exhibited progressive, telomerase-dependent telomere elongation without evidence of DNA damage. The other manifested slow growth, telomere length heterogeneity, single-stranded DNA accumulation and elevated C-circles, which are indicative of telomere deprotection. These telomere deprotection phenotypes are altered or suppressed by mutations in multiple DNA damage response (DDR) and DNA repair factors. We conclude that in yeast, the telomerase inhibition and telomere protection function previously ascribed to the CST complex are mediated jointly by both CST and Polalpha/primase, highlighting the critical importance of a replicative DNA polymerase in telomere regulation.
abstract_zh: Polalpha/primase (PP) 是在复制起点启动DNA合成的聚合酶，同时也在CTC1/CDC13-STN1-TEN1 (CST) 复合物的调控下，通过合成端粒C链来完成基因组复制的任务。利用人源CST-Polalpha/primase-DNA复合物的冷冻电镜 (cryo-EM) 结构作为指导，并结合AlphaFold建模，我们鉴定了酵母CST和PP中促进复合物形成的结构元件。在光滑念珠菌 (Candida glabrata) 的Stn1、Ten1、Pri1和Pri2中突变这些结构，消除了CST对PP在体外的刺激活性，支持了冷冻电镜结构中物理接触的功能相关性，以及酵母与人类之间机制的保守性。将这些突变引入光滑念珠菌后，产生了两个不同的突变体组。一组表现出进行性的、依赖端粒酶的端粒延长，且无DNA损伤证据。另一组则表现为生长缓慢、端粒长度异质性、单链DNA积累和C环升高，这些均指示端粒去保护。这些端粒去保护表型可被多种DNA损伤应答 (DDR) 和DNA修复因子的突变所改变或抑制。我们得出结论：在酵母中，先前归因于CST复合物的端粒酶抑制和端粒保护功能，是由CST和Polalpha/primase共同介导的，突显了复制性DNA聚合酶在端粒调控中的关键重要性。
